Yes. Send us your current quote or contract and we turn it into a template with placeholders, keeping your wording and layout as close as possible.
Which e-signature tools can you connect?

Is a generated contract legally valid?

desc:
Document generation for quotes and contracts turns your approved wording into templates that fill themselves with client and price details. Ecom Swift LLC builds the flow that produces a finished PDF, saves it to the right folder and sends it to the client.

## What is automatic document generation?

Automatic document generation means a template with blank fields, a source of data and a rule that joins them. The data may be a form entry, a CRM deal or a spreadsheet row. The result is a clean PDF with the client name, dates, line items and totals in the right places, created without anyone retyping a thing.

It works for quotes, proposals, service agreements, certificates, offer letters, delivery notes and any other document you produce in a repeated shape.

## Why copying details into Word costs more than it seems

A document built by hand begins with an old file and a find-and-replace. Someone forgets to change a name in the footer, a price is copied from the wrong line, or last quarter's terms stay in by accident. Clients notice, and a mistake in a contract is more than embarrassing: it can start an argument about what was promised.

There is also a quiet time cost. Ten minutes per document seems small until the same task repeats through the week. Meanwhile the approved wording drifts, because every person edits their own copy. Templates keep one version of the truth.

## How it helps your business

The first effect is speed to the client. A quote that goes out within minutes of a conversation is more likely to be read while interest is fresh. The second is consistency: every client sees the same layout, terms and tone, which supports trust.

The third effect is control. When the template is locked and only the fields change, nobody can slip a different clause into a standard agreement. An approval step before sending lets a manager check anything unusual. A status sheet shows which documents are drafted, sent or signed, so follow-up no longer depends on memory.

## What a great document flow includes

- Your own wording and layout converted into a reusable template.
- Merge fields for names, addresses, dates, prices and options.
- Price tables that add rows and totals correctly.
- Rules that choose the right template for each deal type.
- A file name pattern, so documents are easy to find later.
- PDF output saved to a folder organized by client.
- An email to the client with a clear message and the PDF attached.
- An optional approval step before anything leaves your business.
- Signing through the e-signature tool you already use.
- A sheet that tracks each document through drafted, sent and signed.

## How we work

We begin with the documents you already use, in Word or Google Docs. We mark the parts that change, agree on field names, and connect the template to its data source. Then we run sample entries and compare each result to what a person would have typed.

Basic converts one template and fills it from a sheet row. Standard handles several templates with price tables, picks the template by deal type and emails the client. Premium adds approval, e-signature through your own tool, filing of the signed copy and status tracking. We do not rewrite your legal wording. If you want a contract reviewed for legal suitability, that is a job for a qualified lawyer in your area.

## Do and avoid

**Do:**
- Send the exact documents your lawyer or manager has approved.
- Keep field names plain, such as client name and start date.
- Decide which data source is the master, so values never conflict.
- Check the first real documents against the originals.
- Keep a clear folder structure from the start.

**Avoid:**
- Putting free text that changes meaning into merge fields.
- Mixing several versions of the same agreement in one template.
- Sending documents automatically when a person should review them first.
- Storing signed copies in personal inboxes.
- Changing template wording without telling the team.

## Who it is for

A consultant who writes the same proposal every week with different scopes will recover hours. A home services company that sends quotes from a CRM deal can make each quote match the deal exactly. A training provider issuing certificates to every course attendee can produce them in one run from a sheet.

## What we need from you

Send your current templates, a few filled examples and the list of fields that change. Tell us where the data lives and where finished files should be saved. Name the e-signature tool you use, if any. We work as a collaborator or team user in your own accounts, never ask for passwords, and leave every template and automation in your ownership.
